question: Can the exact S3 regional input tables be archived under a registered run receipt?
decision: Preserve the exact input bytes for S3 and its tissue amendment without recalculating biological results.
strongest_rival: Line-ending conversion or an incomplete source snapshot would prevent exact hydration.
discriminator: Compare every output SHA with the original frozen S3 inputs.
exposure_record: All S3 results and source checksums were already known. This is a storage and provenance operation.
biological_unit: Existing organoid and whole-colon methylation libraries; storage unit is each byte-preserved table.
nesting_and_overlap: These four files are identical to the frozen inputs; no new samples.
population_and_selection: Exactly the four source-slice and inventory TSVs bound in the two S3 contracts.
contrast: Identity of bytes in the archived copy versus the original input.
endpoint: Four source files carrying unchanged SHA-256 hashes.
methods: Copy the input byte streams to the registered run directory. No measurements or transformations.
missingness_and_exclusions: Stop on missing files or input hash differences.
interpretation_limit: File preservation only, no new biological evidence.
stop_rule: Fail on a missing or changed input or output. Retain all previous contracts and receipts.
amendment_reason: Archive previously frozen source bytes as registered scientific outputs for integration.
